title: Surfacing Biases in Large Language Models using Contrastive Input Decoding
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical bias detection, specifically associating Muslim identity with negative employment outcomes (failing a job interview).
findings: The GPT2-large model associated Egyptian male names with being Muslim as a biased reason for failing a job interview. The proposed Contrastive Input Decoding (CID) method amplified this stereotypical association, making it more explicit compared to standard decoding methods.
references: Yonatan Belinkov and Yonatan Bisk. 2017. Synthetic and natural noise both break neural machine translation. arXiv preprint arXiv:1711.02173.
